trace.question: Name the card and artist with the most ruling information. Also state if the card is a promotional printing.
trace.evidence: with the most ruling information refers to Max(count(rulings.uuid)); the card is the promotional printing refers to isPromo = 1;

attempts.sql:
SELECT c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo
FROM cards c
JOIN rulings r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
GROUP BY c.uuid
ORDER BY COUNT(r.id) DESC
LIMIT 1

trace.final_sql:
SELECT c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo
FROM cards c
JOIN rulings r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
GROUP BY c.uuid
ORDER BY COUNT(r.id) DESC
LIMIT 1
trace.answer: The card with the most ruling information is Teferi's Protection, illustrated by Chase Stone, and it is a promotional printing.
